enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Place bag on bed. Open bag. Put laptop into bag. Put notebook into bag. Put pen into bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Write notes. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Sit in chair. Discuss program with colleagues. Take notes. Stand up. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Type on keyboard. Open file. Read document. Write notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Order food. Pay cashier. Receive food. Carry tray to table. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Pick up cup. Drink water. Put down fork. Stand up. Carry tray to bin. Scrape food into bin. Place tray on stack. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing community program coordination and partner meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Listen to partner. Write notes. Speak to partner. Turn page. Continue listening. Write notes. Stand up. Walk to whiteboard. Pick up marker. Write on whiteboard. Put down marker. Walk back to chair. Sit down. Discuss plan. Write notes. Walk to desk. Sit down.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Open door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Press power button. Change channel. Watch TV. Put down remote. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Scrub dish. Rinse dish. Open dishwasher. Place dish in dishwasher. Repeat for other dishes. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing the phone quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll screen. Read message. Type reply. Send reply. Lock phone. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read page.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check tomorrow's schedule and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open computer. Press power button. Wait for computer to start. Open calendar. Check schedule. Close calendar. Open email. Read email. Close email. Shut down computer. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
